Jaguar Land Rover in talks to sell military Defender to Nato

Jaguar Land Rover (JLR) is in discussions with Nato countries to sell them its newly revamped Defender military vehicle. The move aims to capitalize on increased defence spending across Europe. JLR is building on its existing relationship with the British armed forces.
